provider_repo: https://github.com/nirholas/XActions (HTTP client vendored in vendor/xactions, Apache-2.0)
note: This file is the honest contract for what Ariana can and cannot do on social media. Every supported action names the real method it maps to. Every unsupported action carries a reason a human can read. X only: the built-in engine talks to x.com's own web endpoints over plain HTTP (no browser).

view_profile.description: Read a public profile: name, bio, headline, and follower/connection counts where the profile page exposes them.

view_posts.description: List an account's recent post URLs.

comment.description: Post a public comment under a post. On X this is a reply to the tweet.

reply.description: Reply to a specific comment or message thread.

connect.description: Send a connection request, optionally with a short note.

dm.description: Send a direct message to one person.

repost.description: Repost / retweet / share someone else's post.

engagement.description: Check follower / following / connection counts for an account.

delete_post.description: Delete one of your own posts.

delete_comment.description: Delete one of your own comments.

twitter.label: X

search.reason: No search method exists in Ariana's X engine yet. She can open a profile or act on a tweet link, but cannot search.

view_profile.returns: display name, bio, followers, following, tweet count, join date

view_posts.reason: No method exists in Ariana's X engine to list an account's posts yet. She can act on a tweet when given its URL.

view_feed.reason: No home-timeline method exists in Ariana's X engine yet.

comment.notes: On X, commenting on a tweet is replying to it.

reply.notes: A reply in X is the same operation as a comment on the tweet.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept; X has no equivalent action.

dm.notes: One message to one person. No bulk.

read_dms.returns: one item per 1:1 conversation: { from, last_message, last_from_me }
read_dms.notes: last_from_me is only true/false when X reports who sent the last message; otherwise null and Ariana stays quiet.

post.notes: Text only — the integration has no media upload path.

notifications.reason: No notifications method exists in Ariana's X engine yet.

engagement.returns: followers, following, tweet count as shown on the profile page

delete_post.reason: No delete method exists in Ariana's X engine.

delete_comment.reason: No delete method exists in Ariana's X engine.

twitter.login: server-side username + password (X_PASSWORD, optional X_EMAIL / X_TOTP_SECRET); session cookies are encrypted into Supabase

unsupported_platforms.facebook: No adapter exists in the integration. Adding one means writing a new handler plus engine dispatch — the dashboard will not offer a Connect button until then.
unsupported_platforms.tiktok: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.threads: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.youtube: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.reddit: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.snapchat: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.pinterest: No adapter exists in the integration.
unsupported_platforms.whatsapp: Not a social feed integration, and Ariana already reaches WhatsApp through her own channel — do not route it through this layer.
unsupported_platforms.instagram: The built-in engine supports X only (the browser-based engine was removed to save memory).
unsupported_platforms.linkedin: The built-in engine supports X only (the browser-based engine was removed to save memory).
